newsitem.title: USA: U.S. chemical industry 96 profits seen $35-$37 bln.
newsitem.headline: U.S. chemical industry 96 profits seen $35-$37 bln.

text.p: The U.S. chemical industry could have a modestly weaker performance in the second half of 1996, compared to the first half, but annual profits could still top the 1995 record of $35.8 billion, a chemical industry trade association said on Tuesday,
If second half performance was weaker, total 1996 profits could be in the $35 billion to $37 billion range, the Chemical Manufacturers Association told Reuters.
If second half performance was similar to first-half, profits would be around $37 billion, CMA said. It said projections were based mostly on first half profit data.
